implementation_scope: Reusable preparation only. Training architectures, relation adapters and solvers are implemented in issues 21/22; decision in 23.

data.training_source: raw MPP finite measured pixels only
data.reference_use: Evaluation after freezing all checkpoints, transforms, thresholds and predictions; never checkpoint or parameter selection.

transfer.containment: Effective support including crop, shifts and interpolation must fit the measured field and guarded band.
transfer.fit_scope: train only for pixel quantiles2/98, PCA, edge median, relation quantiles and any catalogue
transfer.limitation: One correlated acquisition with mostly low-confidence saved registration. Guard8 is not a calibrated error bound; geometrical disjointness is not independent-acquisition generalization.

transductive.scope: All24 full measured fields; separate normalization/PCA/relations and run ID.
transductive.fixed_steps: Per family median of selected checkpoint steps of three transfer z32 runs, before revealing final evaluation.
transductive.checkpoint: Last step at the fixed budget; no checkpoint selection on reference domains.
transductive.claim: Description of the present series, not unseen-data generalization.
transductive.missing_transfer_run: If fewer than3 successful transfer z32 runs of a family, skip its transductive refit with reason; no substitute seeds or extra fits.

sampling.training_weights: Uniform scales, uniform eligible frames, uniform available grid elements within frame.
sampling.centers: All valid centers recorded; inference-only diagnostic, no additional training or selection.
sampling.unavailable: Keep all rows with reason; do not pad or silently drop unsupported elements.
sampling.scale_diagnostics: Apply the same frozen weights at32/64; no new hyperparameter search.

normalization.fit: Each eligible raw train pixel once, not once per overlapping crop; all fields in transductive runs.
normalization.degenerate_fit: high<=low in the fitting pool raises an error; a flat individual crop remains valid input for method-level order/refusal evaluation.

augmentations.SSL_positives: Two mapped views of the same measured patch; compare only common valid positions.
augmentations.AE_target: Clean corresponding spatial patch; preserve known translation mapping.

rvae.latent: continuous content, angle, translation; no categorical count
rvae.decoder: Rotate coordinates and decode intensity through coordinate MLP; no CUDA grid_sample backward.

local_ssl.representation: Spatial local map with known coordinate correspondence
local_ssl.untrained_control: Preserve z32 initial weights for every training seed; no additional fits.

training.checkpoint_selection: Minimum mean unlabelled validation loss; tie earlier step; fixed validation transforms/order.
training.batch_sampling: With replacement; all training batches contain64 entries.

administrative_caps.interpretation: Cost ceilings, not predictions from the technical AE proxy; no automatic budget extension.

measured_budget.limitation: Technical AE proxy does not measure full rVAE or SSL runtime. RSS is process high-water mark; CUDA allocator excludes driver/context.

comparison.primary_support: Same48px grid sites and effective measured support in all four cells.

feature_adapter.edge_distance_normalization: Divide PCA Euclidean distance by median strictly-positive train-edge distance, floor1e-10; no positive edges => degenerate, not one-domain proof

comparison.rvae_descriptor: Concatenate L2(content)/sqrt2 and (cos(theta),sin(theta))/sqrt2, then common adapter; content-only diagnostics separate.
comparison.ssl_descriptor: Flatten local map in fixed spatial order; no global pooling before graph comparison.
comparison.type_policy: No structural type inferred from full orientation-sensitive descriptor. type_id may remain null; ordered_untyped is allowed.

relations.centers_neighbor_rule: min(24,1.65 * median nearest-neighbor distance); separate diagnostic graph
relations.neutral: q25<=d<=q75: no relation; same strict inequalities when quantiles tie

mws.order: Strength descending, repulsive before attractive, canonical endpoint IDs
mws.merge: Only if components have no mutex relation; carry all mutex sets after union

relations.interpretation: Appearance dissimilarity, not calibrated probability or measured translation jump. New sign/weight mapping changes information interpretation together with solver.

refusal_gate.method: windowed_acf mechanism from17/19 adapted to actual new patches
refusal_gate.threshold: Quantile0.999 of all available old-development negative grid scores, once per scale; no new heldout/control truth for calibration.
refusal_gate.material: unknown unless a separately identified material model provides evidence

result_extension.base_assignments: Complete final after-refusal assignments including unavailable/refused elements.
result_extension.relations: Inline relations or relations_artifact with path and sha256.
result_extension.missing: null plus reason; never convert unavailable evidence to agreement or boundary
result_extension.component_vs_domain: Proposal component IDs stay separate from final frame-local domain IDs; no automatic structural types, contours or areas.

evaluation.old_controls: All previously viewed realizations including1701..1703 and2701..2703 are development.

heldout.reveal: After all predictions and plan are frozen; preparation integrity checks are not candidate scoring.

evaluation.coverage_primary_denominator: All evaluable elements with full measured support; also report fraction of all planned grid elements.
evaluation.pair_metrics: pair_scores, separately all valid pairs and actual neighbor edges; zero denominator is null.

boundary.scope: Synthetic contacting positive domains only: two_orientations, different_spacing, phase_boundary, orientation_8deg; exclude disjoint/empty_gap.
boundary.prediction: Midpoints of axial grid edges whose assigned endpoints have different component IDs; no diagonals
boundary.truth: Interface between two distinct positive truth IDs sampled at1reference_px; no outer field boundary and no positive-to-zero interface.
boundary.precision: Fraction of predicted midpoints within tolerance of truth
boundary.recall: Fraction of truth points within tolerance of predicted midpoints
boundary.no_truth_boundary: Report false predicted edges; F1 null
boundary.convention: Half grid stride, not physical contour accuracy; distinct from3px unscored interior band.

matched_coverage.ranking: Shared ACF score descending, then element ID
matched_coverage.restriction: Only levels already attained by both final outputs; no adding refused vertices

TTMAPP.scope: 18 annotated frames, partial interiors only; all24 full overlays
TTMAPP.colors: Orientation-reference groups, not structural classes or numerical angles
TTMAPP.transfer_mask: Only eligible transfer_split=test elements with full support within guarded expandedX[0,160]; full-frame overlays are not heldout metrics.
TTMAPP.transductive_mask: All eligible partial-reference interiors, reported separately from transfer.
TTMAPP.absent_reference_group: Metric null/unavailable, no automatic pass or zero; restrict transfer conclusion to represented regions.

evaluation.gap_metric: disjoint/empty_gap: merge/split and per-component coverage plus false assigned fraction in known empty gap with explicit denominator; boundaryF1 unavailable, no contour claim.

synthetic_units_adapter.formula: synthetic_raw=low+(high-low)*(0.5+0.4*renderer_image), then ordinary frozen normalization and clip.
synthetic_units_adapter.fitting: None on synthetic data; constants fixed by this plan. low/high are the already frozen real-data regime normalizer.
synthetic_units_adapter.meaning: Contrast convention, not physical STM calibration. Nominal+1 ->0.9; inverted-1 ->0.1; noise_sigma0.025 ->0.01.
synthetic_units_adapter.source_arrays: Keep original generated controls immutable; transform only as model input.

continuation.scope: Research continuation, not production acceptance13; evaluate main z32, do not select after heldout results.
continuation.annotation_only_missing: Grid prediction identical before and after gate to full-image counterpart.
continuation.insufficient_field: Unsupported entries insufficient_data, no recognized domain; not a negative zero-domain control.

TTMAPP_useful_coverage.scope: Three-group condition applies to full transductive partial-reference evaluation; transfer reports represented test regions only, absent groups are unavailable and do not support generalization.

continuation.aggregation: Median over3 training seeds, no opposite sign in other seeds; all basic safety/coverage gates for every seed.
continuation.claim_STM_improvement: Benefit on heldout synthetics AND evaluable TTMAPP. Synthetic-only or pre-gate-only benefit is a component finding, not detector improvement.
continuation.no_pass: Report concrete limitation and decide in23; no extra configurations or reopening19.
